input.command: for i in $(seq 1 40); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:14120/); if [ "$c" = "200" ]; then echo "workbench up at $(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ)"; exit 0; fi; sleep 3; done; echo "workbench still $c after 2 min"; tail -n 4 $HOME/.local/state/csf/harness/harness.log | cut -c1-220
